$$
y=(x-2)(x^{2}+x)
$$

at the point $\left(2,0\right)$. Give an exact answer.

$m'=$
{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "229c4819-0721-5a67-b268-0b7d8501a4a0" :question/worked-solution "Let $f(x)=(x-2)(x^{2}+x)$. Expand and combine like terms before differentiating.

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(x)&=x^{3}+x^{2}-2x^{2}-2x\\
&=x^{3}-x^{2}-2x
\end{aligned}
$$

Apply the power rule:

$$
f'(x)=3x^{2}-2x-2
$$

The tangent slope at $\left(2,0\right)$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}
m=f'(2)&=3\left(2\right)^{2}-2\left(2\right)-2\\
&=12-4-2\\
&=6
\end{aligned}
$$

The normal is perpendicular to the tangent, so take the negative reciprocal:

$$
\begin{aligned}
m'&=-\frac{1}{m}\\
&=-\frac{1}{\left(6\right)}\\
&=-\frac{1}{6}
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "229c4819-0721-5a67-b268-0b7d8501a4a0" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "229c4819-0721-5a67-b268-0b7d8501a4a0" :question/answer-fields "f8064394-a467-5621-b670-65d8cde1af82"] [:db/ensure "229c4819-0721-5a67-b268-0b7d8501a4a0" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186092384 :knowledge-point/questions "229c4819-0721-5a67-b268-0b7d8501a4a0"] [:db/add "d38a48de-853d-5f1c-ab46-45101a7d57d9" :answer/id #uuid "d38a48de-853d-5f1c-ab46-45101a7d57d9"] [:db/add "d38a48de-853d-5f1c-ab46-45101a7d57d9" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "d38a48de-853d-5f1c-ab46-45101a7d57d9" :answer/value "-\frac{1}{11}"] [:db/ensure "d38a48de-853d-5f1c-ab46-45101a7d57d9" :answer/validate] [:db/add "8d2b1619-66d8-5b91-9ab5-33a1de776b0f" :answer-field/id #uuid "8d2b1619-66d8-5b91-9ab5-33a1de776b0f"] [:db/add "8d2b1619-66d8-5b91-9ab5-33a1de776b0f" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "8d2b1619-66d8-5b91-9ab5-33a1de776b0f" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "8d2b1619-66d8-5b91-9ab5-33a1de776b0f" :answer-field/choices "d38a48de-853d-5f1c-ab46-45101a7d57d9"] [:db/add "8d2b1619-66d8-5b91-9ab5-33a1de776b0f" :answer-field/correct "d38a48de-853d-5f1c-ab46-45101a7d57d9"] [:db/ensure "8d2b1619-66d8-5b91-9ab5-33a1de776b0f" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "98465be8-fd70-5cdc-bb24-15806a36e6d8" :question/id #uuid "98465be8-fd70-5cdc-bb24-15806a36e6d8"] [:db/add "98465be8-fd70-5cdc-bb24-15806a36e6d8" :question/problem "Find the slope $m'$ of the normal line to the curve

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(x)&=x^{3}+x^{2}-x^{2}-x\\
&=x^{3}-x
\end{aligned}

$$
f'(x)=3x^{2}-1
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
m=f'(-2)&=3\left(-2\right)^{2}-1\\
&=12-1\\
&=11
\end{aligned}
$$

The normal is perpendicular to the tangent, so take the negative reciprocal:

$$
\begin{aligned}
m'&=-\frac{1}{m}\\
&=-\frac{1}{\left(11\right)}\\
&=-\frac{1}{11}
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "98465be8-fd70-5cdc-bb24-15806a36e6d8" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "98465be8-fd70-5cdc-bb24-15806a36e6d8" :question/answer-fields "8d2b1619-66d8-5b91-9ab5-33a1de776b0f"] [:db/ensure "98465be8-fd70-5cdc-bb24-15806a36e6d8" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186092384 :knowledge-point/questions "98465be8-fd70-5cdc-bb24-15806a36e6d8"] [:db/add "6d164aab-26ac-5cf6-9d2a-e3a8042493ec" :answer/id #uuid "6d164aab-26ac-5cf6-9d2a-e3a8042493ec"] [:db/add "6d164aab-26ac-5cf6-9d2a-e3a8042493ec" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "6d164aab-26ac-5cf6-9d2a-e3a8042493ec" :answer/value "1"] [:db/ensure "6d164aab-26ac-5cf6-9d2a-e3a8042493ec" :answer/validate] [:db/add "10465f0c-4337-50c1-8344-ac1800a75eea" :answer-field/id #uuid "10465f0c-4337-50c1-8344-ac1800a75eea"] [:db/add "10465f0c-4337-50c1-8344-ac1800a75eea" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "10465f0c-4337-50c1-8344-ac1800a75eea" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "10465f0c-4337-50c1-8344-ac1800a75eea" :answer-field/choices "6d164aab-26ac-5cf6-9d2a-e3a8042493ec"] [:db/add "10465f0c-4337-50c1-8344-ac1800a75eea" :answer-field/correct "6d164aab-26ac-5cf6-9d2a-e3a8042493ec"] [:db/ensure "10465f0c-4337-50c1-8344-ac1800a75eea" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "13ffce0a-6aca-53fc-b21e-8eedd82600a4" :question/id #uuid "13ffce0a-6aca-53fc-b21e-8eedd82600a4"] [:db/add "13ffce0a-6aca-53fc-b21e-8eedd82600a4" :question/problem "Find the slope $m'$ of the normal line to the curve

$$
\begin{aligned}

&=-\frac{1}{\left(-1\right)}\\

{{field-1}}"] ["e6ca2069-f4a7-54c8-a819-485817a2cc11" :question/worked-solution "Let $f(x)=(x+2)(x^{2}-x)$. Expand and combine like terms before differentiating.

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(x)&=x^{3}-x^{2}+2x^{2}-2x\\
&=x^{3}+x^{2}-2x
\end{aligned}
$$

Apply the power rule:

$$
f'(x)=3x^{2}+2x-2
$$

The tangent slope at $\left(2,8\right)$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}
m=f'(2)&=3\left(2\right)^{2}+2\left(2\right)-2\\
&=12+4-2\\
&=14
\end{aligned}
$$

The normal is perpendicular to the tangent, so take the negative reciprocal:

$$
\begin{aligned}
m'&=-\frac{1}{m}\\
&=-\frac{1}{\left(14\right)}\\
&=-\frac{1}{14}
\end{aligned}
$$"] ["e6ca2069-f4a7-54c8-a819-485817a2cc11" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] ["e6ca2069-f4a7-54c8-a819-485817a2cc11" :question/answer-fields "2dc91774-0db4-5ab3-a2f3-e5feeb1f79d9"] [17592186092384 :knowledge-point/questions "e6ca2069-f4a7-54c8-a819-485817a2cc11"]] "retractions" []}
